verdict.rationale: Make's own docs show that scenarios can be scheduled: there is a 'schedule a scenario' help page, and webhook queues are processed 'every time your schedule criteria are met'. Nothing in the pack shows cron-style expressions or timezone control, so only the basic scheduling core is evidenced. Missing for 10: cron-expression syntax support, timezone configuration, detailed scheduling docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run workflows on cron-style schedules with timezone control

citations.quote: the whole queue is then processed every time your schedule criteria are met
you can schedule your to process all webhook requests periodically
